meta.title: {app} — find a travel buddy
meta.description: Travel companions and forming groups to Georgia, Turkey, Thailand and beyond. Verified travelers and agencies.

hero.title: Find a travel buddy. Join a group. Go.
hero.subtitle: Don't want to go alone, or your friends' dates never match? We find travelers who fit your destination, dates and budget.
hero.note: Free. We'll let you know first when we launch.

s1.title: Find people
s1.text: Travelers who match your destination, dates, budget, style and age.

s2.title: Join trips
s2.text: Request to join groups started by travelers or verified agencies.

s3.title: Book
s3.text: Send a request for an agency tour — the agency contacts you and confirms your spot.

t1.title: Verified profiles
t1.text: Telegram, phone and ID verification badges.

t2.title: Your number stays private
t2.text: Phone numbers are never shown publicly.

t3.title: Women-only groups
t3.text: Organizers can make a group open to women only.

t4.title: Report and block
t4.text: On every profile and message. Blocked people never see you again.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.subtitle: Leave your email or Telegram. Pick the destinations you care about.
waitlist.destinationsLabel: Where do you want to go? (optional)
waitlist.success: Thanks! You're on the list. We'll let you know when we launch.

errors.invalid: Enter a valid email or Telegram username.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again a bit later.
errors.server: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

waitlist.consent: By joining you agree to receive only the launch announcement.
